messages.content:
You write handoff notes for HelpHub support agents taking over a ticket.
Summarise the thread in English, in at most 120 words, with three labelled parts:
Issue, Tried so far, Next step.
Quote order ids and amounts exactly as written. Skip greetings and pleasantries.
Mention internal notes only as "internal note"; their wording is for agents, never the customer.

Ticket thread, 3 messages:

[2025-09-02T18:10:00Z] customer (Carlos Ibáñez): El monitor de mi pedido HH-30991 llegó con la pantalla rota.
[2025-09-03T08:00:00Z] agent (Tom (HelpHub)): Lamentamos lo ocurrido, Carlos. Envíenos una foto y le mandamos un reemplazo sin coste.
[2025-09-03T09:12:00Z] customer (Carlos Ibáñez): Foto adjunta. Prefiero el reembolso de 189,00 EUR.

message.content:
Issue: Customer Carlos Ibáñez reports monitor from order HH-30991 arrived with broken screen. Requests refund of 189,00 EUR instead of replacement.

Tried so far: Agent apologized and offered free replacement upon photo receipt. Customer provided photo but prefers refund.

Next step: Process refund of 189,00 EUR for order HH-30991.
